### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/objectql`, `@objectstack/plugin-audit`, touching **52** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **3** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/objectql/src/index.ts`, `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-seal/index.ts`, `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/index.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**4** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/api/error-handling-client.mdx`  _(via waitMs (symbol, a field of interface AuditSealLockHoldOptions; a field of interface DatabaseSessionLockWait))_
- `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`  _(via os migrate audit-key-material (command, read off packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/audit-key-material.ts), os migrate audit-mail-bodies (command, read off packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/audit-mail-bodies.ts), os migrate audit-metadata-bodies (command, read off packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/audit-metadata-bodies.ts))_
- `content/docs/kernel/cluster.mdx`  _(via waitMs (symbol, a field of interface AuditSealLockHoldOptions; a field of interface DatabaseSessionLockWait))_
- `content/docs/upgrading.mdx`  _(via os migrate audit-key-material (command, read off packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/audit-key-material.ts))_

⛔ **3** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-6.mdx`  _(via os migrate audit-metadata-bodies (command, read off packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/audit-metadata-bodies.ts))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-7.mdx`  _(via os migrate audit-metadata-bodies (command, read off packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/audit-metadata-bodies.ts))_
- `content/docs/releases/v18/18-3.mdx`  _(via os migrate audit-key-material (command, read off packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/audit-key-material.ts))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **3** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/objectql/src/index.ts`, `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-seal/index.ts`, `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/index.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **21** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **58** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 60960cd6a460edfb165edfd956f9fdfd1ae6e0d7` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `e16ce57d0173cbe3e44faa02cd3fcdcb454967f9` — the merge of head `d741b9e9ab26566bee9926e8bdca40cafd6b8906` into base `60960cd6a460edfb165edfd956f9fdfd1ae6e0d7`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `claude/area-A2-31908-p4b2` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin e16ce57d0173cbe3e44faa02cd3fcdcb454967f9 && git checkout e16ce57d0173cbe3e44faa02cd3fcdcb454967f9
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 60960cd6a460edfb165edfd956f9fdfd1ae6e0d7 d741b9e9ab26566bee9926e8bdca40cafd6b8906 && git checkout -B drift-repro 60960cd6a460edfb165edfd956f9fdfd1ae6e0d7 && git merge --no-ff d741b9e9ab26566bee9926e8bdca40cafd6b8906

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 60960cd6a460edfb165edfd956f9fdfd1ae6e0d7
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 60960cd6a460edfb165edfd956f9fdfd1ae6e0d7` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

Area A2, slice P4b3 of #31908: handover on account usage.

Resume-from: claude/area-A2-31908-p4b3@d741b9e9ab26566bee9926e8bdca40cafd6b8906

**Done.** The pins were committed first and ran red before the fix (bfece9b28 and 90f8170a6). The implementation and changeset are in d741b9e9a and pushed. The working tree is clean.
- Green locally at d741b9e9a: `@objectstack/objectql` test (596 files, 13099 tests) and typecheck; `@objectstack/plugin-audit` test (94 files, 1549 tests) and typecheck; `@objectstack/cli` unit tier (421 files, with the two published-subpath pins re-run after a CLI build) and typecheck.
- eslint on the 17 changed TS files exits 0. The control-byte self-scan is clean.
- Live Postgres 16 reading, from a scratch script that was not committed:
  - the key in `pg_locks` is -5564991198496822599
  - a second session's try answers held
  - a wait of 300 ms refuses in 310 ms
  - a wait of 5 s takes the lock 503 ms after the holder lets go
  - `isHeld` reads false after `pg_terminate_backend`
  - `holdAuditSealLock` finish reports a lost session
  - a run with no sealed object takes no advisory lock
  - the schema-migration key is unchanged at 255402229896085448

**Left.**
1. **RED gate `check:cli-command-ids`.** Three user-facing lines quote the backticked command phrase for the `os migrate audit-` family with a star, which the gate reads as a command id. The lines are at `seal-lock.ts:138` and `:142` and `sealer.ts:478`. Fix: reword the three lines so they do not carry a backticked `os ...` phrase; for example, name the three commands, or drop the backticks. Then re-run the plugin-audit audit-seal tests, because the wait and skip lines are matched loosely.
2. **Rest of the derived gate list.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives 78 commands. 31 ran: 29 exit 0, `check:cli-command-ids` exits 1 (above), and `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exits 3 because its fixture needs an unshallow clone (environment, not this diff). 47 are NOT MEASURED (handover): everything from `check:closed-ceremony-text` onward. After that, run `--ran`.
3. **One-time ablation, not run.** The planned ablation is in `seal-lock.ts` `trySealPassLocks`: read a `'held'` answer as no lock. Expect red in "skips the pass while another session holds it" and "a sealer pass skips while a run holds it". The subject resolves through src, so no dist rebuild is needed.
4. **Full dogfood battery at the final head, not run.** It is owed because the title carries `!`.
5. **Not run either:** the CI check-runs read, the review#3 request once CI is green, and the report file under the area's orders directory.

**Notes.**
- The PR body's Clause-② widened list omits the new plugin-audit export `STORED_METADATA_BODY_REWRITTEN_OBJECTS`, which the changeset does name. That is for the seat to amend; a dev does not PATCH the body.
- Stacked base `claude/area-A2-31908-p4b2`, as the order directs. AGENTS.md calls stacked PRs unsupported.
- Shared package touched: objectql. The open PR overlap check found only #33637 touching `sealer.ts`.
